objective: Implement one explicit operator-authorized rollback that appends the exact canonical state of an earlier revision without deleting history or changing the authoritative activation.
success_evidence: Rollback requires the current authoritative activation, an exact expected head, an earlier revision in the same lineage, and structured immutable operator, reason, evidence, and source-authority context.
A successful rollback appends a rollback_applied revision whose parent is the prior head and whose canonical state exactly matches the selected earlier revision.
The current activation and lease remain authoritative while both advance to the appended rollback head.
Cross-lineage, current-head, malformed-evidence, stale-head, integrity-tamper, and non-authoritative attempts fail closed without appending a revision.
Verification proves rollback provenance and canonical-state equality, and the operator CLI completes one deterministic rollback flow.
non_goals: Deleting, rewriting, or moving the lineage head backward to an old revision.
Undoing external filesystem, tool, provider, deployment, database, or workflow side effects.
Transferring authority, changing activation state, creating a new lineage, branching, merging, or adding automatic rollback policy.
Adding a database migration, daemon, watcher, network dependency, parent-repository edit, or provider integration.
accepted_threats: The trusted local operator decides that an earlier canonical state should be reinstated; TORC records but does not independently judge that decision.
Rollback restores only canonical TORC state and cannot reverse external or uncheckpointed transient effects.
The authoritative activation executes the operator decision and remains the bearer after rollback.
Opaque evidence references are integrity-recorded identifiers, not authenticated external attestations.

evidence.rollback_commands: lineage create; lineage checkpoint; lineage rollback; lineage status; verify
evidence.result: Rollback appended an exact earlier canonical state, preserved all revisions, retained the same activation and lease without an authority transition, and verified cleanly.
